text: The app is becoming more and more annoying. Applying limits on everything saying max daily limit exceeded. Some items it just doesn't let me add. And every time I go to the cart, something vanishes. I am seriously thinking of uninstalling the app. You can't decide what I can get. I added items and some items it just removed from my cart because of exceeding the limit. I only added 1 quantity of some of those and so I'm being forced to not order certain items. Do you guys think this is funny?

Missing items in my recent order (1 carrot and 1 beetroot), yet I was billed for them. What’s worse is the complete lack of live customer support — no chat option, only email. For a brand that promotes speed and convenience, the support system is slow and frustrating. Service quality is clearly declining. Very disappointing experience.

I had discount cash available of Rs. 75 and when the order was placed they showed the net amount (with discount) Rs. 361 but on delivery they charged me full amount Rs. 436. They didn't give me any discount. Additionally when I checked my orders on app there was no discount on the bill as well. Its a total scam. Please take Screenshot when the order is confirmed to make sure this doesn't happen with you as well.

(1) Items saved in cart, for ordering at a later point in time, disappear automatically. That's truly torturous!! (2) The so-called 'Free-cash' feature is mostly disabled and hence unvailable to be applied. (3) 80% items are available much cheaper on BlinkIt than on Zepto, and thats very much contrary to Zepto's claim of being the cheapest grocery seller. (4) So many items are so frequently 'out-of-stock' on Zepto, their supply chain or maybe their replenishment process just seems horrible!! :/

I have never experienced such poor service from any app. Today, I waited outside for 15 minutes because the app kept showing "1 minute" while the delivery partner's number was always busy. Then my order was marked as delivered, but I never received it. This has happened repeatedly, along with wrong deliveries. Refunds don't make up for the inconvenience. Despite many complaints, your service has not improved. I have lost trust in your platform and will no longer use it.

Absolutely the worst shopping app experience I've had. Every other order has some issue like missing items, incorrect products, poor quality, or unexplained cancellations. The app promises quick delivery, but what's the point if the order isn't even right? Customer support is beyond frustrating. Instead of resolving genuine problems, they rely on scripted responses and often refuse refunds or replacements even when the mistake is clearly theirs.

Extremely disappointing experience with Zepto. I received a damaged product without the required tag and requested a return within minutes of delivery. The item was picked up, but the app later showed the pickup as failed, and my refund was not processed. Despite contacting customer support multiple times, I did not receive a proper resolution. This caused unnecessary stress, wasted my time, and affected my work. The handling of this issue has been highly unprofessional and unacceptable.

Do not order from Zepto if you're relying on their "Free Delivery on orders above ₹100" offer. I placed an order above the minimum amount to qualify for free delivery. After the order was packed, I was informed that one of the items was out of stock. Instead of allowing me to cancel the entire order, I was told it couldn't be canceled because it had already been packed. This feels unfair. Customers shouldn't have to pay for an order that no longer meets the conditions

If an item is unavailable in the store, don't replace it with a substitute. Instead, simply remove the unavailable item and issue an instant refund for that item's amount. Currently, delivery partners ask customers to either request a refund later or cancel the entire order, which creates unnecessary inconvenience. The world is moving forward, but this process is outdated. Instant refunds for unavailable items, like Blinkit, Swiggy Instamart, and JioMart, would solve problems for all three parti

Very disappointing experience. Zepto promised delivery in 10–13 minutes, kept me waiting for nearly 1 hour, and then cancelled my order without any reason. I was late for the office and had to buy the same items elsewhere at a higher price. There is no customer support call option, only English chat support. Please improve your delivery commitments, customer service, and language support.

Zepto used to be good while they started but recently since last 4-5 months we are observing a trend, a trend of stealing. stealing not directly but always there will be missing items or incorrect items which are of lower value. since I use other quick commerce apps too, I know it is common to see missing items in Big basket or Blink it orders too, but you don't have to seek support or fight for your refund. in Zepto, they will cleverly not send some items or will give you items of lower value

worst app. I have ordered a product but what I have got is an inferior quality product with a broken seal. I have tried to contact the support servies but no satisfactory reply from them. I have even send emails but they are neither willing to accept their mistake nor are they removing the advertisement showing a wrong product. i advise you to purchase product after double check. A product shown as a lower priced product doesn't mean that you have got a great deal. It is a fraud being committed

Very poor service. My order (PNUUJDEWE28008) had 2 items. I gave one defective item to the delivery executive, but he took both items. Now one item is marked “delivered” in the app, but I have not received anything. This is completely unacceptable and shows wrong delivery status and negligence. No proper support has been provided so far. Please resolve this issue immediately.

My experience with Zepto was extremely disappointing. The Zap chatbot failed to understand that products were missing and kept treating it as a delivery delay. There was no option for me or the rider to cancel the order, and customer support only asked me to send an email instead of providing immediate help. This process is frustrating, inefficient, and shows a complete lack of proper customer support

Had a great experience using the app, but with time delivery speed got delayed not a problem,but it never did updated the time properly, as mentioned by others too,before the delivery if it would show 8 mins even after 15 mins it would show 8 mins and nowadays zepto is always in high demand,asking us to come back after 15 mins,but its whole day the same,I'm not being able to order a simple thing for days. So well this is a farewell.

Very disappointing experience. If customer care calls and informs you that one item is damaged, I strongly recommend cancelling the entire order instead of accepting the remaining items. I accepted the remaining items in good faith, expecting the refund for the undelivered item to be processed, but resolving the issue turned into a long and frustrating process with repetitive responses and no proper investigation. Customer support failed to address my genuine concern, and I have completely lost

Fed up with the customer service. The app tells us to email support, but all we get are automated replies saying the seller confirmed the correct product was delivered. So the seller's word matters more than the customer's? Am I blind and unable to recognize what I ordered? Even after receiving the wrong product, they don't properly investigate. Very disappointing support.

The live tracking option when ordering for another is completely ridiculous. It never works for the reciever. I can't track the order because 90% of the times even through the notification that X placed an order for you, it opens to a blank page. And those rare occasions when it does open, it does not show the delivery person's location so you cannot determine where they are making it hard to give instructions to them. Zepto need to do better in this.

Poor customer support and no access to a human agent when needed. Couldn't cancel an order even before it was packed. Also received unsealed products and poor-quality vegetables multiple times. After several bad experiences, I'm seriously reconsidering using Zepto. Many times no cover also when you chose the option for cover and still don't get one.

I normally get things on time but the problem is only with the payment. Not just once or twice in my recent days whenever I try to pay earlier I face some issues, the amount gets deducted from my account the shows payment cancelled. And the refund initiated are delayed too much and sometimes I never get the refund at all . Request the team to look into such issues because it is happening every other day.

I have ordered three items. Zepto assigned two delivery partners. One for two items and one for one item. I only got two items but not the another one it's been more than two hours and still showing order is on the way, delivered in six minutes. There's no response from the side of delivery partner I called him. I have prepaid for this order and now I don't want this item I want a refund. Delivery partner name : MD Ashgar very poor customer service.

it delivers orders so late and gives false hopes that it'll deliver fast. my latest three orders are examples of it. before placing the order, the app says it'll deliver in 7 mins or so. after placing the order it changes to 15 mins and if you actually compare the 15 mins on their app and the actual time it doesn't make sense as the order comes in more than half an hour. what kind of scam is this. blinkit in that is so much better.

Worst experience with the service of Zepto. Few items from my order were missing, when I raised the issue the customer support tells me that everything has been delivered and we can't do anything about it. When I asked the proof from their end they had nothing to show. Why would I raise the issue if everything would have been delivered. Please don't order from them. They are scamming the customers.

Very disappointing. Misleading promotion. The app advertises offers as if they're available to everyone, but after going through the process, you find out they're only valid in certain regions. This important restriction isn't made clear upfront. Please be transparent about regional eligibility in your advertisements to avoid wasting users' time.

The support option in the application is completely useless as it do not provide any option to directly contact a support agent. Also the delivery time keeps getting increased after the payment is done. Before placing order it is like "delivery in 10 mins". After placing order suddenly it is 14 mins. I understand okay, but now it keeps getting delayed and now it is more than 20 mins, and the bot that is suppose to help you, keeps repeating the same lines, without any useful update and reason.

The app is no more to be relied on. First the delivery shows within 5-6 mins and the order doesn't show up for more than 20-30 mins. It's happening every single time. Also there is only bot support to address the issue, who doesn't understand half of the things. Most of the time while placing order it's showing try in next 15 mins. The vegetables which come are also not good enough, very low quality or rotten.

The problem is that refunds are not the solution. Customers don't order groceries just to get their money back later. We order them because we need them. By the time I realize the milk is spoiled, my meal is already delayed, and I have no choice but to place another order. That means I end up paying extra delivery fees, handling charges, platform fees, and other charges just to replace an item that should have been fresh in the first place. App Getting worse day by day.....

Deeply disappointed with the customer service. I reported a missing item from my recent order, but support and the grievance team simply keep repeating that 'the seller confirmed delivery.' They are ignoring the fact that while some items arrived, the order was incomplete. Asking a customer for 'proof' that something was never in the box is absurd. I’ve paid for products I never received and am getting nowhere with their support team. Avoid if you value your time and money! Lost a loyal customer

not recommended at all I ordered some items from Zepto. On several occasions, they have delivered expired products, and sometimes items have been missing from my order. Whenever I reported these issues, my requests were denied, and I was refused a refund. I also have a phone call recording with the delivery partner. As soon as I checked my order and noticed the missing item, I immediately called him. He asked me to contact customer support and then left in the lift without resolving the issue.

Arguably the best instant delivery app which takes no handling fees, unlike other platforms. Generally, almost all the items are cheaper here compared to other apps, while having good quality. Delivery is generally trustworthy and timely. In case of a mistake from their end, the company remains ready to refund the entire amount even without taking back the consumable item. Now, the company has reduced the discounts available. Previously, it used to offer very good discounts.

delivery partners have no accountability. i placed an order ,waited for 45 mins.,delivery partner called and after knowing the location cancelled the order . it hasn't happened just once but multiple times . sometimes even after placing an order and then cancelling it , I haven't received the refund. there's no customer service. no accountability. one just wanders in . who's to question here ?

Zepto is a complete fraud. Needed items urgently, but they delivered the wrong order. I raised a return, and their delivery person came and physically took the items back. Right after he left, the app showed the return "failed." I tried calling support 6 times every call was instantly declined, telling me to use the app. But their app chat is a broken automated loop that does nothing and just closes the ticket. Now Zepto has my money AND they took the items back. Absolutely pathetic service

Very poor experience. My order was marked as "Delivered," but I never received it. I couldn't contact the delivery partner or customer support. Even after emailing with screenshots, Zepto rejected my complaint without providing any proof of delivery. No refund, no replacement, and no proper investigation. Extremely disappointing customer service. ⭐☆☆☆☆

I've ordered 7 items where the delivery was delayed due to one item missing they just called me and informed me that one item is not available and i specifically informed to issue a refund for missing item and ended the call. order was delivered, and the delivery person also said the same that one item is missing. I waited, and no refund was given. When i contacted them via chat, they said all the items were present. when contacted via email, they said the same, and till now, there is no refund.

It was a very disappointing experience , some products were missing from the delivery. I contacted customer support through email and clearly explained the issue, but instead of understanding my concern, they kept saying that all products were sent from their side. No proper investigation, no resolution, and no effort to help the customer. It feels like customer concerns are being ignored completely. I would not recommend this app until they improve their customer support and take responsibility

I ordered from this platform for the first time, and my experience was terrible. I was delivered the wrong product. When I contacted customer support to explain the issue, they ended the chat abruptly without offering any solution. I also sought help via email, but I didn't receive any satisfactory response or support there either. The customer service did not seem professional at all. It was a very disappointing experience for me. For this reason, I will not consider ordering from here again.

Extremely disappointed with Zepto's customer support. I returned a product three days ago, and the app shows that my refund has been processed. However, I still haven't received the money in my bank account. The most frustrating part is that there is no proper way to contact customer support for this specific refund issue. The Help & Support section doesn't even have an option to raise this query or speak to a customer care executive. It feels like you're left with no way to resolve a problem.

pathetic app, they don't accept request to change the time. we have wait for their delay and spoil our work/sleep every time. worst chatbot and support ever. No point of using zepto services as first of all, their number of staff is short hence no order is delivered prior to 20 or 30 minutes. Secondly, always delivered one or more items tempered with an expired date that usually means they delivered the expired items to clean their shelf despite multiple complaints. Now just waiting for a replacement for a product as delivered expired. After that, deleting the app.

This is one of the worst grocery delivery apps I've used. I ordered milk and other groceries, but the vegetables were not fresh and the milk was spoiled—it curdled as soon as I heated it. I ordered my things and the delivery driver refused to give the order to me and the agent also can't do anything. The worst delivery app ever. A very poor experience it will give you.

Worst Delivery Experience. I have faced this issue so many times, not just once. The delivery is shown as arriving in a few minutes, but in reality it takes 30 minutes, 1 hour, and sometimes even 2–3 hours. If they cannot deliver on time, they should increase the estimated delivery time honestly instead of showing false short delivery times. Showing 6 minutes and delivering after 30+ minutes is misleading. The brand should seriously fix this issue.

They show offers, different products and do not refund if the product is unavailable. the app showed offers and when the offer is used no cash back nor any reply from cc. I tried to reach out customer support through email, and instead of helping, I received the same message over and over again (10) messages inspite of sharing the requested details

Zepto used to be my go to for groceries. Errors might happen sometimes, but the customer care was responsive. In recent times I'm not able to raise query in help and support due to a bug in the app. there is no customer care contact number as well. At this point it feels like I'm being scammed. You don't get as per the order you've given and there is no way to escalate the issue. Amazon Now offers much better support.

Pathetic App Today when I made an order the money was deducted and they cancelled the order itself. Also when I made the next attempt 1 item was missing. After that if you go for a chat they will just tell you that refund will be initiated within 4-7 days. I mean what the hell, what about my time that I wasted on your app. I would have rather got it from the shop. Also the product gets delivered in terrible condition and low quality.

The service has been so bad. They promise a 10 minute delivery which usually takes 30-40 minutes - I'm okay with the time of 30 minutes, but not told 10 minutes and continuously waiting on the order. Plus a complete lack of a support team you can reach out to resolve your issue or order delays or cancellations. Absolutely frustrating experience.

This is the second time Zepto has cancelled my order after making me wait nearly an hour. The product was clearly shown as available, and the app even allowed me to select the maximum quantity before placing the order. After 55 minutes, I received a call saying the item was out of stock. If the product isn't available, why is it being shown in the app at all? People use quick-commerce platforms for convenience and time-sensitive purchases. Wasting customers' time like this is unacceptable.

Zepto ain't it anymore. Tried ordering meals 2 nights in a row at around midnight and both nights the order kept getting delayed for more than an hour, and eventually got cancelled. Both nights. While the app kept showing that they are delivering. Utter non sense, since I couldn't order from any where else. Had to go to sleep without the munchies.

Absolutely pathetic experience. I placed an order, but the assigned rider never moved from the starting location. ​When I tried to get help, the AI support was totally broken—it couldn't cancel the order and kept falsely claiming it "will be delivered in 1 min". It was stuck in an endless loop with no option to cancel an order that was never on its way, also no option to speak to a real human. It took over 3 hours for Zepto to finally cancel the stalled order. How is this acceptable?

A year ago, this was one of the best delivery apps. Today, it's a complete disappointment. My order had a missing item worth ₹620, yet the app offered no option to report it. I contacted support via email, but my refund claim was rejected. On top of that, deliveries are frequently unavailable due to "overload" issues. Poor customer support, unreliable service, and a sharp decline in quality have convinced me to uninstall the app and never use it again. Good bye Zepto. You don't care so i don't.

I had a very frustrating incident on this app. I ordered an item on this platform thinking they would deliver it on time. They were taking a lot of time so I tried to cancel it. After a long time I some how managed to cancel the order and now the refund would take long grueling 5-7 business days whereas they accept payments within minutes .

I cannot even review the delivered products clearly. Everytime it asks for a photo, the app goes blank. How the hell am I supposed to report? There are a lot of issues. The rider's phone was switched off, and the chatbot provided only generic responses despite me requesting a call from the support team. After wasting over 20 minutes with support, I had no option but to cancel the order. Blinkit has been far more reliable in my experience

initially, the service was good. but lately I am experiencing lots of delay in receiving the order. But that is not the case, the scam is they don't update the timing. Even 15 mins after i placed the order, the app shows 8 mins in delivering the order. Sometimes it is very frustrating that you are waiting for the order as it is urgent, and the time on the app is not changing. Today is my frustrating day .

something fishy with the pricing logic. I’ve added products to my cart when prices were low, only to find them increased the very next morning. This has happened 3 times now with different items. It feels like the app tracks interest and hikes prices to force an immediate purchase. Very disappointing experience for a regular user.

One of the worst customer experiences I've had with a delivery app. Zepto advertised a 7-minute delivery time, which was the only reason I chose to place the order. The moment the payment was completed, the estimated delivery time suddenly jumped to 30 minutes. What made the experience even worse was the refusal to allow an immediate cancellation. If a customer places an order and cancel immediately. should have no resistance to cancel

This Zepto app is one of the most untrustworthy and unreliable apps I've ever used. I'm really angry because I ordered some items and have been waiting 2 hours for delivery. The delivery person was also very rude. This isn't the first time. it's happened to me 3 times now. The delivery was the wrong item, and one item wasn't delivered at all, but they took my money and haven't refunded me. The system is really unprofessional. Please update your system.

Decent discounts and product catalog, but it always shows false information regarding delivery time. Also, the product handling is pretty bad; I'm consistently receiving damaged goods. Another reason for this low rating is the lack of customer support. You can keep talking to the AI chatbot, but it will continue to be useless.

Worst customer support ever. Had issues with delivered items multiple times. The support team won't trust issues raised by customers. They don't even ask the delivery person what has happened to understand the issue. We can't upload already captured photos as proofs, what if we don't have time to raise complaint instantly and raise after sometime when item is not available! "We can use this app only when no other instant delivery app is available".

Zepto is fast and always open unlike Big Basket. Recently they have delivered less number of items and then refunded the money for misding items. This makes it look like there is a gap between the supply available and the one shown in the app. At times that missing item was the one I needed most urgently and i added items. However if i want to return any item where i ordered by mistake I have to accept it. Help for this issue in not traceable by me. this whole process is for Zepto's benefit.

I had a very disappointing experience with Zepto's exchange process. I requested an exchange for a product because it was uncomfortable and poor in quality. The app approved the exchange and created a replacement order, but at no point was I given an option to choose a different product. The term "exchange" is misleading because it simply sends the same product again instead of allowing customers to swap it for another item. To make things worse, there was no clear option to cancel the exchange

Very disappointed with this app. The delivery partner is so rude and doesn't known the location at all. I have explained the route and location. still he didn't know it. Finally he just told that he was not ready to deliver ,so u can cancel the order. I did cancel the order and asked for a refund. This behaviour is totally unacceptable. Didnt expect this much from zepto.

Most of the delivery is delayed, it doesn't arrive within the given time. My payment always fails in the first attempt, i always have to pay twice before ordering since they don't give options for COD and i receive the deducted amount after 3/4 days. This app needs faster refunds for payment failure but overall, it's a good app for groceries with huge discounts in various products although they charge extra for certain things like meat and accessories.

Extremely disappointed. I accidentally placed an order when I dropped my phone, and I soon realized there is absolutely no way to cancel or edit an order in the app. Even customer support refused to help. It’s shocking that a modern app doesn't allow for basic corrections or accidental clicks. I wanted to add more items, but instead, I’m stuck with an incomplete order I didn't mean to send yet.

This app is so disappointing. I placed my order almost half an hour ago, but the app keeps showing "8 minutes" remaining. I'm unable to contact support, and I can't even cancel my order. This is a very poor experience.

One product was missing from my order, and the seller did not send the missing product even after I raised a complaint. They only ask for seller confirmation and do not consider the customer’s complaint. Also, the app crashes when I try to take or upload a photo while raising the complaint. don't order anything from this app this is a fake app I placed an order for over 1000, but some items were missing from the order. When I asked for help, they only gave the same answer. Order promised in 8 minutes but after waiting nearly 1.5 hours and repeatedly contacting support, it was ultimately canceled. After waiting an additional 30 minutes, I requested a refund as I could not wait any longer. Only then was the order cancelled, and I was told the refund would take 5–7 days. I had to keep following up for action to be taken, which was very frustrating.

it was great when I first installed it. I even recommended it to my friends and family members. but nowadays it is taking extremely unusual delays in delivering orders, no transparency about what is going on inside this company. I might doubt that something has changed internally which makes the customer suffer. they need to fix it...even I was ordering my groceries every month through this app but now I'm thinking twice what if the order did not get delivered at all or takes more time.

Additionally, the milk packets I receive are consistently spoiled, which has happened every single time I purchased them. There are also frequent mistakes where I receive the wrong items instead of what I ordered. Overall, my experience has been very disappointing due to these recurring issues."

one star is too high for the app as the customer service is very very very poor.
